功能导览看到哪一步: Where you stopped in the feature tour
打开功能导览后，记下你看到哪一步；下次从那一步接着看。: When you open the feature tour, the step you reached is kept, so next time you continue from there.
首页的入门三步: The three first steps on the home
还没有自己的题组时，学习库首页是入门三步；点「以后再说」后，它缩成首页里的一张小: Until you have a deck of your own, the library home shows the three first steps; after “Maybe later” they shrink to a small card on the home.
课程准备里点了「稍后」的步骤: Course setup steps put off with “Later”
课程准备清单里点「稍后」的步骤会先收起来。: A step of the course setup checklist that you put off with “Later” is folded away.
一门课的准备步骤都做完时，说一次就收起。: When every setup step of a course is done, this is said once and then folded away.
提问的是哪一页: Which page you are asking about
第一次在原始 PDF 旁提问时，说明问的是哪一页、怎么换页。: The first time you ask beside the original PDF, it says which page is asked about and how to change it.
预设问题和发给主会话: Preset questions and Send to the main chat
第一次看到预设问题时，说明点一下就提问，图表或扫描页可以发给主会话。: The first time you see the preset questions, it says one click asks, and that a chart or a scanned page can be sent to the main chat.
打开只保存了文字的资料时，说明可以补上原文件；关掉后缩成一行。: When you open a material that only kept its text, it says the original file can be added; once closed, it shrinks to one line.
主题还没归入主题组: Topics not yet in topic groups
主题多、还没归入主题组时提醒；点「稍后」后，等未归组的主题有变化再提醒。: Shown when many topics are outside topic groups; after “Later” it waits until the ungrouped topics change.
在知识骨架页推荐开源插件 Archify；点「以后再说」后不再出现。: The knowledge outline page recommends the open-source plugin Archify; after “Maybe later” it does not appear again.
总纲重新整理后，说一次哪些笔记移到了新位置；下次重新整理还会再说。: After the course outline is rebuilt, it says once which notes moved; the next rebuild says it again.
第一次打开 Jev 设置时，一步步介绍它能替哪些地方做判断。: The first time you open the Jev settings, it walks you through the decisions it can make for you.
没能保存：这个浏览器现在不让保存设置（比如无痕窗口），刷新后会恢复原样。: Not saved: this browser does not let settings be saved right now (a private window, for example); after a reload it is back as it was.
引导提示已关闭：主动出现的提示和卡片不再出现。: Guidance tips are off: tips and cards that appear by themselves no longer appear.
「{0}」会在你下次打开「{1}」时再出现。: “{0}” appears again the next time you open “{1}”.
已重新显示 {0} 项：{1}。下次打开对应的页面时会再出现。: {0} brought back: {1}. Each appears the next time you open its page.
「显示引导提示」现在关着，主动出现的那几项要等打开后才会出现。: “Show guidance tips” is off, so the ones that appear by themselves wait until it is on.
第一次用到某个功能时，StudyHub 会给一句提示或一张卡片。这里可以把它们关: The first time you use a feature, StudyHub may show a tip or a card. Here you can turn them off, or bring back one you have seen. These choices are kept in this browser only.
关掉后，主动出现的提示和卡片都不再出现；首页的入门三步、模型设置的引导，以及出错: When off, tips and cards that appear by themselves stop; the three first steps on the home, the model setup guide, and the help on an error or an empty page still show.
有 {0} 项已经看过。重新显示后，它们会在你下次打开对应的页面时出现，不会马上: {0} seen. Shown again, they appear the next time you open their page, not right away.
现在没有看过的提示，不需要重新显示。: No tip has been seen yet, so there is nothing to bring back.
这个浏览器现在不能保存设置（比如无痕窗口），这一页的改动记不住。: This browser cannot save settings right now (a private window, for example), so changes on this page are not kept.
每一项在哪里出现、什么时候出现。看过的可以单独再显示一次。: Where and when each one appears. One you have seen can be brought back on its own.
「显示引导提示」关着时，上面的单项开关不起作用，打开后恢复各自的设置。: While “Show guidance tips” is off, the switches above do nothing; once it is on, each goes back to its own setting.
没有点它也会出现。总开关和它自己的开关都能让它不再出现；以后新加的这类提示，每天: Appears without being asked for. The main switch and its own switch can keep it away; tips of this kind added later appear at most once a day and never during practice.
